Courgette Spread
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, February 11, 2010 - 8:47pm

Ingredients




4 mediums Courgette shredded
6 mediums Scallions cut into pieces
1 tablespoon Lemon Juice
teaspoon Sugar
teaspoon Salt
teaspoon White Pepper
teaspoon Dill Weed
16 ounces Nonfat Sour Cream
Courgette slices for garnish

Preparation

1 Squeeze shredded courgette to remove excess water; place in food processor or blender container. Add next 6 ingredients; process until smooth. Stir 2 In sour cream until well combined. Chill. Garnish. Serve with crackers. 3 NOTES :MAKES: 16 servingsSERVING SIZE: 2T
